title: Compact inner approximation of W ∩ E inside an open W ⊆ U for a measure finite on compact subsets of U
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and μ a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Let E ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, W ⊆ U open and c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < μ(W ∩ E). Then there is a compact set K ⊆ W ∩ E with c < μ(K).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet E → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ E) → ∃ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ W ∩ E ∧ c < μ K
